description: This file contains implementation for Python bindings related to saved variable hooks in PyTorch's autograd system. It manages hooks to save and restore tensor data during computation, including handling of Python objects and interactions with the Python Global Interpreter Lock (GIL). It defines classes and functions to push, pop, and retrieve hooks, as well as manage their lifecycle.

classes.name: PySavedVariableHooks
classes.description: Handles Python hooks for saving and unpacking tensors within autograd, managing Python object references and interactions with the Python interpreter.

methods.description: Calls the registered unpack hook to retrieve a tensor from saved data.

methods.description: Retrieves stored data related to the unpack hook, returning wrapped Python objects.
